{{< include latex-macros/macros.qmd >}}

::: remark

Probability and statistics use several number systems:
the integers and natural numbers that count,
and the rational, real, and irrational numbers that measure.
This page defines them and the words (even, odd, rational, irrational)
that sort their members.

:::
